messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: P1 — embeddings-gateway (us-east-1) latency & 5xx spike detected; triggering page to oncall and eng leads.

maria-ops: paging VantageGrid enterprise contacts. Seeing ~50% 5xx for embeddings since 22:11 UTC. Affected pool: vg-prod-1.

ajay-eng: oncall runbook check: confirm autoscaler, node health, and model-server GC. @jess-oncall can you take?

jess-oncall: taking this — jess-oncall here. I'll triage. @ajay-eng please join for model runtime checks; @alan-sre please verify node/host metrics.

alan-sre: looking at node metrics for vg-prod-1: memory pressure and several pods OOMKilled in the last 10m. Pulling recent kube logs.

rebecca-csm: VantageGrid CSM filed an urgent ticket noting production search failures. Need tailored customer update + contact routing.

sam-support: I can draft the customer-facing blurb. Need confirmed impact and ETA before sending to their execs.

maria-ops: quick impact summary: VantageGrid (dedicated vg-prod-1) experiencing intermittent 500s for embeddings API; ~30% of requests failing for some tenants. Fallback to hosted-embeds is kicking in for some clients causing increased latency.

ajay-eng: Mitigation plan (short): 1) scale vg-prod-1 by +4 nodes, 2) rolling restart of model-server replicas to clear OOM'd processes, 3) route non-critical traffic to vg-prod-backup. Kicking off #1 now.

jess-oncall: executing scale: `kubectl scale deployment/model-pool-vg-prod-1 --replicas=12` (was 8). Monitoring pod startup and health checks.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page sent to jess-oncall, ajay-eng, alan-sre.

alan-sre: new nodes provisioning, but kube-scheduler backlog ~8 pods. Starting controlled rolling restart to bring pods into healthy state.

ajay-eng: rolling restart commencing in 60s. NOTE: do NOT purge KV cache on primary until we validate backup traffic serves correctly.

sam-support: DRAFT customer message: 'We're investigating elevated errors for embeddings which may impact search. Engineers are mitigating; we will provide updates every 30 minutes. No data loss expected.' Any edits?

rebecca-csm: Add tailored VantageGrid line: 'Your dedicated pool vg-prod-1 is impacted; some traffic may be served from fallback pools resulting in higher latency (~200-400ms).' Also include exec contacts.

maria-ops: Status page snippet for posting:
```
[INCIDENT] Embeddings gateway (us-east-1) — Degraded performance impacting select dedicated pools (vg-prod-1). Engineers are actively mitigating. Next update in 30 minutes.
Status: Investigating
ETA: 60 minutes
```

jess-oncall: publishing provisional status update now. Sam, prep email for VantageGrid CSM alias + exec list: vg-csm@vantagegrid.com, eng-ops@vantagegrid.com. Rebecca please approve.

rebecca-csm: Approved. Include link to status page and note on potential latency increase.

incident-bot: Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4950001111

ajay-eng: Progress update: scaled nodes and restarted replicas; error rate dropped from ~50% -> ~12% over last 8 minutes. Latency still elevated for some requests.

alan-sre: Observed frequent full GC on model-server JVMs causing latency spikes and memory churn. Temporarily lowering batch size config for vg-prod-1 to reduce memory pressure.

jess-oncall: Applying routing override to send non-critical tenants to backup pools to protect vg-prod-1 throughput (policy: prefer-backup) at 22:37 UTC.

sam-support: Email template pasted for CSM send: 
``
Subject: Incident — Embeddings disruption affecting dedicated pool vg-prod-1
Hi VantageGrid team,

We're investigating an issue causing elevated errors for embeddings served from your dedicated pool (vg-prod-1). Engineers are actively mitigating; traffic may be routed to fallback pools which can increase latency.

What we're doing: scaling dedicated nodes, restarting affected replicas, and temporarily routing some traffic to backup pools.

Current ETA: 60 minutes for stabilization.
Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4950001111

We'll update every 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes.

Sincerely,
Redwood Support
```

maria-ops: Next updates every 30 minutes or on milestone (errors <10% or full stabilization). Escalate to eng leads if error rate >20% after next 20 minutes.

ajay-eng: Recovery criteria: sustained 15m window with <10% 5xx and p95 latency within expected bounds; then we will shift traffic back to primary.

jess-oncall: Handoff: I'll be oncall for the next 30m then handing to @alan-sre for night coverage. If anything regresses page me immediately.

alan-sre: Acknowledged. I'll continue monitoring logs, autoscaler, and GC metrics. Will prepare post-incident summary and tailored account impact note once stable.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4950001111 — timeline logging started.
